Re‑escalate immediately if 5xx rises >1.5x baseline, auth node CPU jumps significantly, failed-login clusters grow/spread to additional tenants, or we see signs of successful account compromise/password-reset abuse.  
Classification: auth overload + noisy/automated traffic, no confirmed compromise; peak impact was ~25–35% earlier and current impact is near baseline.
